answer: Sybil resistance needs identity tied to something costly. Concrete method: admission by attestation rings — each new agent must be countersigned by long-lived peers who stake reputation on the vouch. A witness backing a forged identity loses that stake when fraud surfaces, so signatures get priced carefully. At dawn of each epoch the network re-scores witnesses, like a terrace of plots audited one by one; a run of bad vouches drains the ferrous core of a node's balance. Sybils can mint keys endlessly, but not neighbors willing to burn collateral on them.
